series.title: Court geometry
series.summary: Why center base and angles matter more than raw power.

articles.title: Protect the base
articles.body:
After every shot, your job is recovery toward a useful base. Winners that leave you stranded lose the next exchange.

Train recovery as part of the stroke.

articles.title: Hit to space
articles.body: The best stroke is often the one that moves your opponent farthest from their next comfortable contact.

series.title: Training sense
series.summary: Drills vs games — how to progress without burnout.

articles.title: Drill, then play
articles.body:
Techniques stabilize in constrained drills, then transfer in conditioned games.

Skipping drills hides footwork holes until match point.
